title: Team chat
summary: Add an isolated realtime staff chat with one team room and secure private conversations.
changes: Anaesthetic Team provides one permanent group chat for active authorised roster users, with private one-to-one conversations between registered members.
Messages are normal text only and never change the roster or create a swap workflow.
Private chats and sender identity are enforced with Supabase Row Level Security, and the chat directory contains names only, never email addresses.
Chat loads recent messages only when opened, paginates older history and uses a separate Realtime channel so roster features remain independent.
